verseText: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’ This is the first and greatest commandment.
meaning: Out of all the commandments in the Bible, there is one that is most important of all: to love God with all that we are and all that we have, more than anything else in the world.
